scientific_integrity: Analytic Perron–Frobenius and Foster–Lyapunov proof; deterministic finite-state algebra checks support but do not substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite positive-rate complete networks only; finite-first-moment and conditional finite-second-moment thresholds, not a thermodynamic limit or all stationary-law existence. General multitype catastrophe priority remains to be independently checked.
title: Sharp mean–variance spectral phase boundaries in a locally resetting finite zero-range network
